name: anvil-mobile
description: anvil mobile app — Capacitor shell around the anvil server UI (remote) and the offline WebGPU model (local)

scripts.build:android: npm run sync-web && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:linux: npm run sync-web && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: npm run sync-web && npx cap sync ios
